zones.name: Coastal dunes
zones.blurb: State forests planted on the moving dunes between 1801 and 1876.

zones.name: Médoc
zones.blurb: Moors west of the Médoc vineyards, Hourtin to Saumos.

zones.name: Pays de Buch
zones.blurb: Around the Arcachon basin, home of the old La Teste pine forest.

zones.name: Landes bordelaises
zones.blurb: The moors south and west of Bordeaux: Cestas, Saucats, Landiras. Chambrelent's trials began here.

zones.name: Born
zones.blurb: Lakes and forest behind the dunes: Biscarrosse, Parentis, Mimizan.

zones.name: Grande Lande
zones.blurb: The heart of the old moorland: Sabres, Pissos, Solférino, Luxey.

zones.name: Marensin & Maremne
zones.blurb: The southern massif from Lit-et-Mixe and Castets down to Dax and the Adour.

zones.name: Bazadais & Albret
zones.blurb: The north-eastern edge: Bazas, Captieux, Casteljaloux, Houeillès. Old oak woods and more farmland.

zones.name: Petites Landes
zones.blurb: Roquefort, Gabarret and the sands north of Mont-de-Marsan, where the forest meets Armagnac.

claims.note: France Assureurs update of 16 Oct 2026, a ceiling ("could reach"). 81% private property, 15% professionals, 4% vehicles. Includes temporary rehousing and other small claims
Same update, Gironde and Landes only, a ceiling. About 400 homes with claims above EUR 150,000; 183 homes burned in Le Porge
